title: 小狼毫添加词库
content:
深蓝词库转换将搜狗scel格式的词库转换成txt格式
双拼就是选择无拼音纯汉字

文件修改在用户目录
新建mycs.dict.yaml
--- name: dict_sougou_standard  #自定义的词库的名字，不加后缀 version: "2016.10.29" sort: by_weight use_preset_vocabulary: true ...词库文件放在这里
总词库rime_ice.dict.yaml增加
---import_tables:  - mycs...
完成

title: 博客搭建记录
content:
前言  最初的博客完全使用了bilibili上的一条视频1,之后的工作基本上交给豆包
完成。都是些不算大程度的界面变更，只为满足个人的需要。修改集中在hexo和主题的
_config.yml文件中，目录结构如下。
├── build.sh├── _config.landscape.yml├── _config.yml├── db.json├── package.json├── package-lock.json├── public│   ├── 2026│   ├── archives│   ├── css│   ├── images│   ├── index.html│   ├── js│   ├── search.json│   └── tags├── scaffolds│   ├── draft.md│   ├── page.md│   └── post.md├── source│   ├── archives│   ├── _data│   ├── images│   ├── js│   ├── _posts│   └── tags└── themes    └── next

地基  根据视频创建了博客。  hexo版本8.1.2 next版本8.29.0  由如下命令创建：
hexo init bloggit clone https://github.com/next-theme/hexo-theme-next.git themes/next
package.json如下：
{  "name": "hexo-site",  "version": "0.0.0",  "private": true,  "scripts": {    "build": "hexo generate",    "clean": "hexo clean",    "deploy": "hexo deploy",    "server": "hexo server"  },  "hexo": {    "version": "8.1.2"  },  "dependencies": {    "hexo": "^8.0.0",    "hexo-deployer-git": "^4.0.0",    "hexo-generator-archive": "^2.0.0",    "hexo-generator-category": "^2.0.0",    "hexo-generator-index": "^4.0.0",    "hexo-generator-searchdb": "^1.5.0",    "hexo-generator-tag": "^2.0.0",    "hexo-next-darkmode": "^0.1.11",    "hexo-renderer-ejs": "^2.0.0",    "hexo-renderer-marked": "^7.0.0",    "hexo-renderer-stylus": "^3.0.1",    "hexo-server": "^3.0.0",    "hexo-theme-landscape": "^1.0.0",    "hexo-word-counter": "^0.3.0-rc.1"  }}
更改了站点设置，并且配置了部署到github
修改页面改动的部分1.hexo new page tags2.hexo new page archives3.主题的_config.yml  
#1 creative_commons:   # Available values: by | by-nc | by-nc-nd | by-nc-sa | by-nd | by-sa | cc-zero   license: by-nc-sa   # Available values: big | small   size: small   sidebar: false   post: true   # You can set a language value if you prefer a translated version of CC license, e.g. deed.zh   # CC licenses are available in 39 languages, you can find the specific and correct abbreviation you need on https://creativecommons.org   language: zh-CN#2 custom_file_path:   #head: source/_data/head.njk   #header: source/_data/header.njk   #sidebar: source/_data/sidebar.njk   #postMeta: source/_data/post-meta.njk   #postBodyStart: source/_data/post-body-start.njk   #postBodyEnd: source/_data/post-body-end.njk   #footer: source/_data/footer.njk   #bodyEnd: source/_data/body-end.njk   variable: source/_data/variables.styl   #mixin: source/_data/mixins.styl   style: source/_data/styles.styl#3 darkmode: false#4 # Sidebar Avatar avatar:   # Replace the default image and set the url here.   url: /images/avatar.jpg   # If true, the avatar will be displayed in circle.   rounded: false   # If true, the avatar will be rotated with the cursor.   rotated: true#5 # `Follow me on GitHub` banner in the top-right corner. github_banner:   enable: true   permalink: https://github.com/blackdui#6 codeblock:   # Code Highlight theme   # All available themes: https://theme-next.js.org/highlight/   theme:     light: default     dark: stackoverflow-dark   prism:     light: prism     dark: prism-dark   # Add copy button on codeblock   copy_button:     enable: true     # Available values: default | flat | mac     style:   # Fold code block   fold:     enable: true     height: 500   # Display language name   language: true#7   GitHub: https://github.com/blackdui || fab fa-github#8   pjax: true # For more information: https://github.com/rqh656418510/hexo-next-darkmode, https://github.com/sandoche/Darkmode.js darkmode_js:   enable: true   bottom: '64px' # default: '32px'   right: 'unset' # default: '32px'   left: '32px' # default: 'unset'   time: '0.5s' # default: '0.3s'   mixColor: 'transparent' # default: '#fff'   backgroundColor: 'transparent' # default: '#fff'   buttonColorDark: '#100f2c' # default: '#100f2c'   buttonColorLight: '#fff' # default: '#fff'   isActivated: true # default false   saveInCookies: true # default: true   label: '🌓' # default: ''   autoMatchOsTheme: true # default: true   libUrl: 'https://blackdui.github.io/js/darkmode@1.5.7.min.js'# Set custom library cdn url for Darkmode.js#9#安装hexo-generator-searchdb使用本地搜索功能local_search:  enable: true  # Show top n results per article, show all results by setting to -1  top_n_per_article: 1  # Unescape html strings to the readable one.  unescape: false  # Preload the search data when the page loads.  preload: false
4.安装hexo-footnote使用脚注5.安装hexo-word-counter主配置文件_config.yml内容   
symbols_count_time:  symbols: true              # 开启文章字数  time: true                 # 开启阅读时长  total_symbols: false       # 页脚全站总字数，不需要就false  total_time: false          # 页脚全站阅读时长  exclude_codeblock: true    # true：不计代码块里的文字（推荐）  awl: 2                     # 中文单字长度固定2  wpm: 300                   # 每分钟阅读300汉字，可自行调整  suffix: "分钟"

 font-weight: 700;  font-style: normal;  font-display: swap;}// ========== 代码块使用 JetBrains Mono ==========.highlight pre, pre code, .hljs  font-family "JetBrains Mono", Consolas, Menlo, monospace  font-size 14px// ========== 全局链接取消下划线，hover显示 ==========a  border-bottom: none  &:hover    border-bottom: 1px solid $blue// 主页文章、文章详情页的标签 a 链接.posts-expand .post-tags a  background #409eff  // 蓝色，可改成 #007bff / #0066cc  color #fff          // 文字白色，不然蓝色背景看不清  padding 2px 8px  margin 0 4px 4px 0  border-radius 4px  border none  &:hover    background #337ecc // hover 深蓝// 代码块高亮body.darkmode--activated  .hljs    display block    overflow-x auto    padding 0.5em    background #f8f8f8    color #333  .hljs-comment, .hljs-quote    color #998    font-style italic  .hljs-keyword, .hljs-selector-tag, .hljs-subst    color #008000    font-weight bold  .hljs-number, .hljs-literal, .hljs-variable, .hljs-template-variable, .hljs-tag .hljs-attr    color #008080  .hljs-string, .hljs-doctag    color #d14  .hljs-title, .hljs-section, .hljs-selector-id    color #900    font-weight bold  .hljs-subst    font-weight normal  .hljs-type, .hljs-class .hljs-title    color #458    font-weight bold  .hljs-tag, .hljs-name, .hljs-attribute    color #000080    font-weight normal  .hljs-regexp, .hljs-link    color #009926  .hljs-symbol, .hljs-bullet    color #990073  .hljs-built_in, .hljs-builtin-name    color #0086b3  .hljs-meta    color #999    font-weight bold  .hljs-deletion    background #fdd  .hljs-addition    background #dfd  .hljs-emphasis    font-style italic  .hljs-strong    font-weight bold// darkmode.js 环境，代码块选中，不受全局反相影响.highlight ::selection, pre ::selection  background rgba(66, 139, 202, 0.45) !important  color #222 !important.highlight ::-moz-selection, pre ::-moz-selection  background rgba(66, 139, 202, 0.45) !important  color #222 !important::selection  background rgba(66, 139, 202, 0.32)  color #222::-moz-selection  background rgba(66, 139, 202, 0.32)  color #222
